text.en:
The Cabinet Secretariat shall serve as the Secretariat
of the Council of State.

Executive Order No. 305 dated September 9, 1987 is
hereby modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately
upon approval.
City of Manila, January 16, 2003.
By the President.
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
PoMA Hologram * 17676
